listX.text: [L21-L24,L37-L38,L49] (MED/incremental-dependencies) Included Fortran sources are declared as library dependencies instead of object dependencies, so edits can relink the library without recompiling the affected code.
[L18,L34,L48,L65-L70] (MED/module-dependencies) No prerequisite orders compilation of netcdf or netcdf4 after generation of the typeSizes module.

[L18,L34,L40,L48,L51,L65-L74] (MED/parallel-build) The convenience library generates .lo objects while module targets request separate .o objects from the same sources, allowing competing module-file generation.
[L65-L70] (MED/generated-file-recovery) The module targets provide no recipe to regenerate a missing module when the corresponding object remains up to date.
[L63-L70,L84] (LOW/cleanup) The cleanup list omits the uppercase module filenames explicitly supported by the installation rules.

listY.text: [L63-L70,L84] (LOW/build-cleanup) When UPPER_CASE_MOD is enabled, the generated TYPESIZES.mod and NETCDF.mod files are declared as installed headers but CLEANFILES removes only lowercase typesizes.mod and netcdf.mod, so uppercase module artifacts may remain after cleanup.
